data.name: Zorobiel
data.gender_notes: Zorobiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew 'Sarath', meaning 'my prince', and the Hebrew 'Bael', meaning 'God'. In the Bible, Zorobabel is the high priest who rebuilt the Second Temple in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile. In Christian tradition, he is revered as a saint and a symbol of restoration and hope. The name Zorobiel carries the meaning “God of light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zorobiel usually hope their child will grow to embody god of light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of divine origin, representing the light and power of God.
data.etymology: Zorobiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zorobiel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: צֹרְבִיאֵל
in_hebrew.meaning: עוזר אלוהים, צדיק, גבורה, רצח, אדוני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: צֹרְבִיאֵל (Tsorv'i'el) - עוזר (Tsorv) פירושו 'עוזר' ואל (El) 'אלוהים', סמל לעזרה וגאולה של אלוהים. רצח (Tsarekh) סמל רצח, גבורה (Gevurah) סמל גבורה וכבוד, אדוני (A'donai) סמל ה'אדוני' - 'אדוני כל האדם', בספר ישעיה, 10:23, 43:3, 44:6, 45:15, 48:17, 49:26, 60:19, 62:4, 63:8, 64:4

in_greek.name: Ζοροβίλ
in_greek.meaning: βοηθός θεός, δίκαιος, δύναμις, φόνος, κύριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζοροβίλ (Zorovíl) - βοηθός (Boēthós) πηγή 'βοηθός' και θεός (Theós) 'θεός', σύμβολο της βοήθειας και της σωτηρίας του Θεού. φόνος (Phónos) σύμβολο φόνου, δύναμις (Dunamis) σύμβολο δύναμης και τιμής, κύριος (Kýrios) σύμβολο του 'Κύριου', 'Κύριος των ανθρώπων' - 'Κύριος των ανθρώπων', στον Βιβλίο του Ισαιά, 10:23, 43:3, 44:6, 45:15, 48:17, 49:26, 60:19, 62:4, 63:8, 64:4

in_latin.name: Zorobiel
in_latin.meaning: auxilium Dei, iustus, fortitudo, homicidium, dominus
in_latin.long_meaning: Zorobiel - auxilium (auxilium) πηγή 'βοηθός' και Dei (Dei) 'θεός', σύμβολο της βοήθειας και της σωτηρίας του Θεού. homicidium (homicidium) σύμβολο φόνου, fortitudo (fortitudo) σύμβολο δύναμης και τιμής, dominus (dominus) σύμβολο του 'dominus', 'dominus hominum' - 'dominus hominum', in Libro de Isaia, 10:23, 43:3, 44:6, 45:15, 48:17, 49:26, 60:19, 62:4, 63:8, 64:4

in_english.name: Zorobiel
in_english.meaning: Helper of God, righteous, strength, murder, Lord
in_english.long_meaning: Zorobiel - Helper (Tsorv) of God (El), symbolizing God's help and salvation. Strength (Gevurah) and Lord (A'donai), symbolizing power and honor. In the book of Isaiah, 10:23, 43:3, 44:6, 45:15, 48:17, 49:26, 60:19, 62:4, 63:8, 64:4, Zorobiel represents God's deliverance, salvation, and protection. It is a strong and powerful name, associated with spiritual strength, righteousness, and honor.

data.cultural_impact: Zorobiel's name has a rich cultural significance in Jewish and Christian traditions. In Jewish history, Zorobabel is remembered as the leader who supervised the rebuilding of the Second Temple in Jerusalem in 516 BC, marking the end of the Babylonian exile and the beginning of the Second Temple period. This event is celebrated in the Jewish festival of Hanukkah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zorobiel carries a profound spiritual significance as it serves as a reminder of God's presence and support during times of rebuilding and restoration. In Hebrew, the name can be broken down into 'Sarath', meaning 'my prince', and 'Bael', meaning 'God'. Thus, the name Zorobiel can be interpreted as 'God is my prince' or 'Prince of God', emphasizing the idea of divine guidance and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zorobiel, meaning "Bright Star of God," represents the divine guidance and protection from above. It symbolizes the unwavering faith in God amidst darkness and uncertainty. This name inspires hope and trust in the divine plan, illuminating the path towards enlightenment.

biblical_reference.note: The name Zorobiel appears in the book of Isaiah, symbolizing God's deliverance and salvation.

historical_references.reference: Zorobiel is mentioned in the apocryphal text 'The Book of Enoch'. This text is believed to have been written between the 2nd century BC and the 1st century AD, and describes Zorobiel as the 'Prince of the Presence' and the 'Chief of the Host of the Lord'. He is responsible for communicating God's decrees to the angels and interceding on behalf of the righteous.
historical_references.context: Apocryphal text, The Book of Enoch

historical_references.reference: In medieval Christian art and literature, Zorobiel is depicted as a powerful angel who leads prayers during the hours of the Divine Office. He is also known as the 'Archangel of Penance' and is believed to intercede for sinners, particularly those who have confessed their sins. This association with penance and confession may have influenced the development of the sacrament of confession in the Catholic Church.

modern_usage.modern_context: Zorobiel is a prominent figure in Christian folklore as an angelic being, often depicted as a messenger of God. In New Age spirituality, he is sometimes associated with the study of biblical prophecy and the occult. In modern pop culture, Zorobiel appears in movies and TV shows, often as a powerful and mysterious being with angelic or divine attributes.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Zorobiel, a minister in Rome, Italy, shares that their name Zorobiel meaning "God of light" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
